corrections.value: Pinned gen.pollinations.ai/package.json deploy:production runs from the workspace directory and uses ../node_modules/.bin/wrangler; build:production explicitly sets CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production before Vite. Pinned production workflow invokes that workspace script, then reads deployments from the repository root using ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler and explicit --config gen.pollinations.ai/wrangler.toml --env production. That config has name pollinations-gen and env.production routes gen.pollinations.ai/gen.myceli.ai plus production service/database bindings. The two working directories therefore select the same app/environment; they are not competing relative paths from one cwd. Build/Vite/plugin/npm lifecycle code is executable and not classified safe. Source workflow shows automated production-branch deployment, not a manual approval gate; external branch controls are unknown.
corrections.reason: Make cwd/config and Vite environment correspondence explicit, without calling build hooks safe or inventing approval.
